description:
**Position Title: Integration Release Manager**
===============================================

**Location : Hyderabad**

  

**About Opella**
================

**Opella is the self-care challenger with the purest and third-largest portfolio in the Over-The-Counter (OTC) and Vitamins, Minerals & Supplements (VMS) market globally.** Our mission is to bring health in people’s hands by making self-care as simple as it should be, serving half a billion consumers worldwide and counting.

At the core of this mission are our loved brands, global teams, manufacturing sites, and specialized science and innovation centers. Headquartered in France, Opella is the maker of brands including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale, and Mucosolvan.

**As a globally certified B Corp company,** we are active players in the journey toward healthier people and planet.

**About the job**
=================

Join Opella’s Integration Platform team as Release Manager and take full accountability for release management across the global integration landscape. The role owns the end-to-end release lifecycle for integration changes, from planning and readiness through CAB decision-making, deployment coordination, post-release validation, reporting, and continuous improvement.

This is a dedicated operational leadership role designed to provide focus, consistency, and accountability. The Release Manager acts as the central point of coordination across Integration, application teams, Quality, Security, Operations, projects, and external partners to ensure releases are safe, predictable, compliant, and business-aligned.

**Main responsibilities**
=========================

* Own, define, and continuously improve the end-to-end release management process for all Integration Platform changes and deployments.

* Prepare, maintain, and communicate the integrated release calendar, aligning deployment windows, release trains, business priorities, dependencies, constraints, and support coverage.

* Lead release planning and readiness reviews, confirming that build, testing, documentation, approvals, operational handover, monitoring, rollback, and validation requirements are complete.

* Coordinate CAB preparation and participation, including change assessment, impact analysis, risk evaluation, stakeholder alignment, decision logging, and escalation of unresolved concerns.

* Facilitate go/no-go decisions and hold clear authority to recommend postponement or rejection when release quality, compliance, or operational readiness is insufficient.

* Oversee the creation, quality review, approval, and execution of release and cutover plans, including sequencing, dependency management, rollback strategies, and post-deployment checks.

* Coordinate production deployments across integration middleware, and supporting tooling.

* Ensure adherence to Opella governance, security, quality, data privacy, and applicable regulatory requirements, including GxP and SoX controls where relevant.

* Coordinate post-release validation, monitor stabilization, ensure defects and issues are correctly tracked, and lead post-implementation reviews for significant or unsuccessful releases.

* Maintain release dashboards, KPIs, decision records, audit evidence, and stakeholder reporting to provide transparent visibility of release status, risk, performance, and upcoming demand.

* Analyze release performance and release-related incidents to improve success rate, schedule predictability, deployment reliability, automation, cycle time, and stakeholder experience.

* Drive adoption of standardized release templates, checklists, controls, communication practices, and automation across all integration teams, markets, and technology platforms.

* Maintain close collaboration with product owners, architects, project managers, developers, testers, platform teams, application teams, service management, and operational support.

* Own and evolve release-related artifacts in ServiceNow and the integration catalog, ensuring traceability between changes, interfaces, technical assets, approvals, and production outcomes.

**About you**
=============

**Technical background required**
---------------------------------

* 10+ years of experience as part of a release management ecosystem, with demonstrated 3+ years on end-to-end ownership of complex enterprise releases.

* Proven experience leading release governance, CAB coordination, change assessment, release readiness, go/no-go decisions, deployment control, and post-release reviews.

* Strong practical knowledge of ITIL Change Enablement and Release Management, software development lifecycle practices, DevOps, CI/CD, and deployment automation.

* Experience coordinating concurrent releases across global, cross-functional teams in complex cloud, on-premise, and hybrid environments.

* Good understanding of enterprise integration technologies, API lifecycle, messaging and event-driven patterns, middleware, managed file transfer, data integration, and interface operations.

* Familiarity with technologies such as SAP Integration Suite, API gateways, iPaaS, Azure, observability platforms, Git-based delivery, Infrastructure as Code, and ServiceNow.

* Good understanding of application, infrastructure, network, security, and operational dependencies relevant to production integration deployments.

* Experience working in regulated or compliance-driven environments is strongly preferred, particularly with GxP, SoX, information security, auditability, and data privacy controls.

* Experience with SAP and ERP integration landscapes is an advantage.

* ITIL v4 certification is preferred. Additional certifications in project management, Agile, DevOps, or change management are an advantage.

**Soft skills required**
------------------------

* Exceptional organization and coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple releases, dependencies, priorities, and stakeholders simultaneously.

* Strong judgment and decision-making under pressure, with the confidence to challenge readiness and escalate risk when required.

* Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to translate technical release details into clear business impacts and executive updates.

* Demonstrated ownership, accountability, attention to detail, and commitment to disciplined execution.

* Ability to influence without direct authority and build trust in a global matrix organization.

* Calm, structured, and solution-oriented approach during high-pressure deployment windows and production issues.

* Proactive continuous-improvement mindset, with a strong orientation toward automation, simplification, quality, and measurable outcomes.

**Why us?**
===========

At Opella, you will enjoy challenging, purposeful work and be empowered to improve how critical technology changes reach production. This role offers the opportunity to establish a consistent global release discipline for Integration Platforms and to directly influence delivery speed, operational resilience, compliance, and business continuity.

**We Are Challengers.**
=======================

* **All In Together:** We keep each other honest and have each other’s backs.

* **Courageous:** We break boundaries and take thoughtful risks with creativity.

* **Outcome-Obsessed:** We are personally accountable, driving sustainable impact and results with integrity.

* **Radically Simple:** We strive to make things simple for us and simple for consumers, as it should be.

**Join us on our mission. Health. In your hands.**

**Position Details**

**About the Role**

We are seeking a hands-on Tech Architect to define and drive the technical direction of our SaaS platform. You will architect and build scalable backend web services; design analytics pipelines for drone-captured images and videos; enable enterprise-grade single sign-on (SSO) and a secure, extensible integration layer; and turn proofs of concept (POCs) and prototypes into reliable, production-ready systems. You will also champion AI/LLM-powered agentic coding to improve engineering productivity, while setting high standards for security, quality, scalability, and operational readiness.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define end-to-end architecture for a multi-tenant SaaS platform, balancing scalability, performance, security, availability, and cost.
* Assess existing POC and prototype code, determine what can be reused versus re-architected, and define a practical path to production and go-live.
* Production-harden prototypes through robust error handling, logging, monitoring, automated testing, security controls, configuration management, and performance tuning.
* Own production-readiness reviews, load and performance testing, CI/CD and deployment strategies (including blue-green and canary releases), rollback plans, and post-launch support.
* Architect scalable analytics pipelines for drone-captured imagery and video, covering live-stream and bulk-field-upload ingestion, processing, model inference, storage, and API-based delivery of results.
* Address drone-data constraints, including large high-resolution media, intermittent or low-bandwidth connectivity, GPS and flight telemetry, altitude, gimbal/camera orientation, timestamps, and mapping data to missions, sites, and assets.
* Make architecture decisions for real-time versus batch processing, GPU/accelerator utilization, edge versus cloud inference, and cost optimization for media-heavy workloads.
* Architect enterprise identity and SSO using SAML 2.0, OIDC, and OAuth 2.0; support per-tenant SSO configuration, integrations with Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, and Google Workspace, SCIM provisioning, RBAC, and session management.
* Design and own the platform’s extensibility and integration layer, including public APIs, webhooks, SDKs, and plugin/extension models for customer, partner, third-party, drone-platform, and fleet-management integrations, with versioning, backward compatibility, and safe sandboxing.
* Own end-to-end security architecture, including API gateway and WAF controls, authentication and authorization, encryption in transit and at rest, secrets and key management, audit logging, and tenant data isolation.
* Drive secure-by-design practices through threat modelling, security reviews of designs and code, dependency and vulnerability management, and penetration-test remediation—including for AI-generated code and third-party extensions/integrations.
* Architect and oversee backend services, including REST/GraphQL APIs, microservices, and service-to-service communication.
* Remain hands-on: write and review production-grade backend code, build POCs, and demonstrate engineering standards by example.
* Design core SaaS capabilities such as multi-tenancy, subscription and billing integration, tenant data isolation, rate limiting, and horizontal scalability.
* Lead adoption of AI/LLM agentic coding tools such as Claude Code for delivery acceleration, refactoring, and productionizing prototype code.
* Establish workflows and best practices for AI-assisted software development, including code-review standards, guardrails, and quality gates for AI-generated code.

**Tech Architect | Job Description**

* Define technical standards, coding guidelines, and architectural patterns across engineering teams; evaluate and recommend technologies, frameworks, tools, and emerging AI/LLM and computer-vision capabilities.
* Partner with product managers and stakeholders to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions.
* Review and approve high-level designs (HLDs), guide low-level designs (LLDs), identify technical debt, and lead legacy-system modernization, using AI-assisted tools where beneficial.
* Ensure architecture meets non-functional requirements for scalability, availability, security, tenant isolation, and observability.
* Mentor senior engineers and tech leads on architecture, productionizing prototypes, and effective use of AI coding assistants.
* Lead POCs for new technologies, LLM/agentic workflows, vision models, and major system changes.
* Collaborate with DevOps/SRE teams on infrastructure, deployment, and CI/CD architecture.
* Own architecture documentation and keep it current across the organization.

**Required Qualifications & Technical Skills**

* 10–15 years of software engineering experience, including significant experience in architecture-focused roles.
* Proven experience building and scaling SaaS products end to end, ideally from early-stage development through growth.
* A demonstrated track record of taking POCs/prototypes to production through refactoring, re-architecture, hardening, and successful live launches with measurable reliability and performance.
* Strong backend engineering experience designing, building, and scaling production REST/GraphQL APIs and microservices.
* Experience designing or building systems that ingest and process drone-generated aerial imagery and video at scale, including use cases such as object detection, change detection, classification, tracking, and inspection.
* Understanding of video streaming protocols (RTSP, RTMP, WebRTC, HLS), encoding/transcoding, and large-scale media storage.
* Experience with drone data and metadata, including geo-tagged imagery, flight telemetry, geospatial context, and data flows from device or ground station to cloud.
* Familiarity with production deployment and serving of computer-vision/ML models, including inference optimization, GPU workloads, batching, and model versioning; exposure to OpenCV, FFmpeg, or similar frameworks.
* Hands-on experience implementing enterprise SSO and authentication using SAML, OIDC, OAuth2, and SCIM in multi-tenant SaaS products, including integration with major identity providers.
* Experience designing extensible platforms with public APIs, webhooks, SDKs, and plugin/extension or third-party integration frameworks, including versioning, rate limiting, and safe extension isolation.
* Strong security architecture skills covering API security, encryption, secrets management, tenant isolation, secure SDLC, threat modelling, and OWASP Top 10 risks and mitigations.
* Mandatory hands-on coding capability; this is an active engineering role, not solely an architecture-review position.
* Practical, demonstrable use of AI/LLM-based agentic coding tools (e.g., Claude Code) in real engineering workflows, beyond casual use.
* Strong expertise in system design, distributed systems, and microservices architecture.
* Experience with multi-tenant architecture, subscription billing systems, and SaaS scalability patterns.
* Hands-on experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP, including managed GPU/ML and media services.
* Deep proficiency in at least one major backend language/stack: Java, Python, Node.js, .NET, or Go.
* Deep understanding of SQL and NoSQL databases, data modelling, caching strategies (Redis or Memcached), and object storage.
* Strong experience with API design, API gateways, messaging/streaming systems such as Kafka or RabbitMQ, and service-integration patterns.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing strategies, and production observability, including logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting.

CredX is a verification\-first hiring platform for India. Every candidate's identity, education, and employment are independently verified before an employer sees them. The badge they carry is only worth something if the system behind it is airtight, which is why this role exists.

Incorporated in the US, built in Hyderabad, launching this month.

Stack: Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, AWS, Razorpay.

**The seat**

* You are the backend. Not a backend engineer on a team. The backend.
* Every schema, every API contract, every transaction boundary, every architectural tradeoff is yours to make and yours to defend. There is nobody above you to escalate to and nobody below you to delegate to.
* You work directly with the founder. Full context, fast decisions, no layer between a decision and production.

**What you will own**

* Architecture. The backend across billing, verification, hiring, users, roles, and admin. Schema design, indexing strategy, transaction boundaries, and audit trails. You set API contracts before the frontend starts building, not after.
* Billing. The full lifecycle: plans, credits, mid\-cycle changes, proration, renewals, failed payments, and reconciliation. Signature\-verified webhooks, idempotency that actually holds under retries, and a backend that is the single source of truth for what a customer is entitled to. Razorpay is primary; Stripe is possible later.
* This is the part of the system we care most about getting right. Billing errors do not surface as bugs. They surface as a customer conversation you cannot win.
* Core systems. RBAC across Super Admin, Admin, Hiring Manager, Recruiter, and Applicant. Verification and document processing workflows. Authentication and authorization with JWT and Spring Security. REST APIs with validation and error handling that survive contact with reality.
* Production. Delivery from design to release, incident response, and long\-term reliability. When it breaks at 2AM, it is yours.

**What we need**

* 3 to 6 years of Java and Spring Boot, designing production systems from scratch rather than extending someone else's.
* Deep PostgreSQL: Schema design, query optimization, indexing, and transaction semantics you can reason about under concurrency.
* Production payment systems experience. Subscription or credit lifecycles, webhooks, proration, and entitlement enforcement. We mean systems that handled real money, not a side project integration.
* System design judgment. You find the bottleneck before it finds you, design for failure as the default case, and make tradeoffs deliberately rather than by accident.
* JWT, Spring Security, and RBAC design that holds up when a new role is added in month eight.
* Fluency with AI tooling, Cursor, Copilot, Claude, or equivalent, used to ship more rather than as decoration.
* Comfort owning everything with nobody assigning you work.
* Nice to have: Razorpay Subscriptions or Stripe Billing specifically, AWS deployment and storage, KYC or document verification workflows, planning API contracts alongside an Angular team, and prior founding team experience.

**Compensation**

* ₹10L to ₹12L fixed depending on depth.
* 0\.25\-0\.50% equity, four\-year vest, one\-year cliff. This is a founding seat, and the equity says so. We are not using the word to justify a smaller number.

**Not a fit if**

You want an existing architecture to extend, a tech lead to escalate to, or someone else on call. You want remote or hybrid. You are optimising for the highest cash offer, which will not be us.

**How we hire**

A deep technical conversation with the founder, mostly system design. A walkthrough of something you built where the data model was hard. Then a paid take\-home, roughly four hours, on a real billing or entitlement problem from our system. Three steps, inside two weeks.

Email: connect@credxhire.com, subject: Founding Backend Engineer, your name. Send your CV, GitHub if you have one, and one paragraph on a schema or architecture decision you made that you would still defend today.

We are looking for a mature, hands\-on Senior Technical Lead who can bring structure, predictability and ownership to the engineering and release process for Stratpilot.

**Release Management**

* Ensure developers understand requirements and technical expectations; identify blockers and risks early.
